_comment: All numbers in this file are sourced from official government/regulator publications. Do NOT change any numeric value without updating the corresponding 'source' field with the new citation.

spr.source: PIB press release pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1694712 + Rajya Sabha RTI reply, 23 Mar 2026
spr.note: current_fill_pct is dynamic per government statement. Flag in UI that this figure may have changed; re-verify against ISPRL/PPAC disclosures before final demo presentation.

refinery_stock.note: Represents aggregate petroleum product stocks held at refineries and depots across India.

calculation_inputs_needed: monthly crude import volume by source country (from PPAC published Monthly Import Data)
average voyage transit time by route: Gulf (Iraq/Saudi/UAE/Kuwait) ~10-15 days, US Gulf Coast ~30-45 days, Russia via Suez ~25-30 days, West Africa (Nigeria) ~20-25 days
India's average daily crude consumption in barrels/day (from PPAC Daily Petroleum Report)
on_water.note: No official live figure exists for in-transit crude. This value is derived via calculate_on_water_days() using import_mix.json. Never label this as 'live' or 'real-time' in the UI — always display with 'Estimated' badge.
